properties.CITATION: Mohanty, A., Yadav, S., 2019; Macro - Scale (1:50,000) landslide susceptibility mapping in parts of Toposheet Nos. 78 J/7, 8, 11, 12 and 83 B/4 in Goalpara, Bongaigaon, Barapeta districts, Assam and West Garo Hills, Ri-Bhoi districts of Meghalaya.
properties.PRE_REMEDIAL_MEASURES: The slope stabilization may be carried out by reducing the slope angle and plantation of small plants.
properties.GEOSCIENTIFIC_CAUSE: Due to excessive slope cut for road widening, the slope became unstable and failed aided by rainfall .

properties.CITATION: Mohanty, A., Yadav, S., 2019; Macro - Scale (1:50,000) landslide susceptibility mapping in parts of Toposheet Nos. 78 J/7, 8, 11, 12 and 83 B/4 in Goalpara, Bongaigaon, Barapeta districts, Assam and West Garo Hills, Ri-Bhoi districts of Meghalaya.
properties.PRE_REMEDIAL_MEASURES: The slope stabilization should be addressed by reducing the slope angle and plantation of small plants may be done.
properties.GEOSCIENTIFIC_CAUSE: Excessive slope cutting has lead to slope being sub-vertical, the slope failed during heavy rainfall.
